content.title: Protect yourselves
content.summary: Know how to shield heads and necks once you reach your shelter room.

sources.label: National Weather Service — Tornado Safety: During

skill.cue: You are in your shelter room and the tornado warning is still in effect.
skill.action: Cover your heads and necks with your arms and put blankets around or on top of you.
skill.why: Ready.gov says to watch out for flying debris.
